channel.title: One Fire Record: Myanmar
channel.description: Is this month's fire activity normal for Myanmar? NASA MODIS and VIIRS fire detections joined into one record since 2000.

item.description: 1,003 fire detections. In the 25 earlier Octobers on record, the middle year had 349. Near-real-time data: provisional.
